Forgejo 17.0 is now available, bringing a suite of improvements for developer workflows.

This release enhances Forgejo Actions with support for Markdown-formatted summaries, tables, and charts.

Other technical additions include refined Git LFS management, automatic group invitation expiration after 14 days, and a new migration tool for Bitbucket Data Center.

The version 17.0 release cycle will be maintained until Jan…
